name: Kuroya Naori
source:
[url=/c11258]Yuzuru’s[/url] son and the heir of the Kuroya Clinic. He’s [url=/c11248]Ayato[/url] and [url=/c11239]Karen’s[/url] cousin and old friend. He’s a boy who thinks about things outside of the box, and is quite clever too. He’s studying to become a doctor to take over the hospital. 

Naori came up with all of his friends’ nicknames. 

"...I’m not sure what there is to be happy about lately, though."

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
